objective: Replace device-count/QEMU-only accelerator evidence with a fail-closed physical-device qualification gate.

sources.requirement: DMA buffers, mapping, synchronization, DMA masks, and error paths must follow the Linux DMA API.
Dedicated accelerator memory must be distinguished from system memory; TTM/GEM/VRAM paths require memory-management evidence.
IOMMU groups are the minimum secure ownership/isolation unit; topology and ACS limitations must be reviewed because DMA is the critical device-isolation risk.

required_controls: PCI BDF, vendor ID, device ID, stable identity, and device type
signed vendor/upstream driver module provenance and firmware hashes
IOMMU enabled, driver, group membership, group isolation, DMA protection, ACS/topology review
physical VRAM total/free values with allocation, reclamation, accounting, and isolation tests
DMA mask, mapping, synchronization, unmap, fault containment, IOMMU translation, and arbitrary-access denial
reset recovery, stress, multi-tenant isolation, driver error recovery, and physical workload tests
physical observation, operator confirmation, hardware-attestation class, and accountable release authority

coverage: synthetic structured hardware report accepted by validator
QEMU-only mode rejected when hardware is required
synthetic_regression.claim_boundary: The positive fixture is cryptographic policy testing only and is not physical-device evidence.

existing_software_baseline.scope: QEMU/software isolation, accounting, and sanitizer evidence only; no physical GPU/NPU, VRAM, IOMMU, DMA, or vendor-driver qualification.

blocked_reasons: No physical GPU/NPU is visible in the sandbox inventory.
No IOMMU group is visible for an accelerator.
No physical VRAM measurement is available.
No physical DMA mapping/fault-containment test is available.
No vendor-driver or firmware provenance is available for a physical device.
No operator-observed physical workload/reset/recovery evidence is available.
claims_not_made: No VRAM capacity or isolation claim.
No IOMMU/DMA safety claim for a physical accelerator.

release_status.external_completion: Run the signed JSON report on an operator-controlled host with a real GPU/NPU, IOMMU enabled, vendor driver and firmware provenance, physical workload/stress/recovery tests, and independently review the evidence.
